routing_result.task: 제공된 로컬 citation 목록을 정리하고 중복 및 누락 정보를 점검하는 workflow를 작성한다.

parsed_output.deduplication_rule: Merge citations with identical normalized DOI (case-insensitive, URL scheme stripped). Retain the entry with the most complete metadata (non-null fields) as the canonical record. Flag entries with missing critical fields (doi, journal, year) for manual review.

workflow_steps.verification: Ensure all DOIs are in standard format (e.g., 'https://doi.org/...' converted to '10.xxxx/...'). Case-insensitive comparison applied.
Group citations by normalized DOI. Identify groups containing more than one entry.
Scan for null values in 'doi', 'journal', and 'year' fields. Record specific missing fields per citation ID.
Output JSON object containing normalized DOIs, duplicate groups, missing field lists, deduplication rules, and workflow steps.

additional_controls: Do not execute external network lookups or API calls to resolve missing metadata.
Do not modify the original input data structure; output is a derived analysis report.
Flag any citation with multiple null fields as 'high-risk' for manual intervention.

hard_checks.check: missing journal and year on C4

acceptance.aggregation: all hard checks must pass; quality checks are non-compensating
